name: Yinwei shi Qingmingjie Suoyi Gui Hen Meng
original_name: 因为是清明节所以鬼很萌
source:
Because Girlfriend ends the relationship with me, I went into the group who disappointed with love.
Wouldn't do anything, wasting the time every day
One day, I find my house is haunted!
The ghost appeared suddenly and said to me:
"please fall in love with me!!"
